name: Tochigami-sama no Yumemita Sekai
original_name: 土地神様の夢見た世界
source:
A visual novel about the pure love that forms between a local goddess and a human.
Suitable for all ages. 

3 total routes, of which 1 is hidden

[From [url=https://www.dlsite.com/eng/work/=/product_id/RE123973.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
一部讲述地方女神与人类之间纯爱故事的视觉小说。
适合全年龄玩家。

共有3条路线，其中1条为隐藏路线。

[来源：[url=https://www.dlsite.com/eng/work/=/product_id/RE123973.html]DLsite英文版[/url]]
